map.临界角存在条件？: What are the conditions for the critical angle to exist?
map.须光从光密(n大)射向光疏(n小)且入射角≥θc，反方向无全反射。: Light must travel from the denser medium (larger n) to the rarer medium (smaller n) with an incident angle ≥ θc; the reverse direction has no total internal reflection.
map.全反射有折射光吗？: Is there refracted light in total internal reflection?
map.没有折射光，能量全反射回原介质，但存在倏逝波（用于干涉/传感）。: There is no refracted light; the energy is totally reflected back into the original medium, but an evanescent wave exists (used in interference/sensing).

map.临界角 θ_c = arcsin(n₂ ÷ n₁) × 180÷π，仅当光密介质: Critical angle θ_c = arcsin(n₂ ÷ n₁) × 180÷π; total internal reflection exists only when the denser medium n₁ > the rarer medium n₂; when n₁ ≤ n₂ the page directly shows "n₁>n₂ is required for total internal reflection" without an angle; it also outputs n₁÷n₂ and the relative difference (n₁−n₂)÷n₁×100%.
